feed.title: Measured
feed.subtitle: Developer concepts, with numbers you can reproduce.

entry.title: Batching writes, measured: one transaction vs one per row
entry.summary: 10,000 inserts into a SQLite file: a commit per row, batches, or one transaction, in three journal modes on a real SSD. Why the commit is what costs, and what WAL and synchronous=NORMAL trade away.

entry.title: Pagination, measured: OFFSET vs keyset
entry.summary: Paging through one million rows with LIMIT/OFFSET and with a keyset cursor: how OFFSET slows down page by page and repeats or loses rows when data changes. With an in-browser SQLite demo.

entry.title: Retries, measured: why backoff needs jitter
entry.summary: 200 clients retry against a busy server: immediately, with exponential backoff, and with jitter. Measured against a real server, with a simulator.

entry.title: The N+1 query problem, measured
entry.summary: 1,001 queries versus 1 or 2: measured in-process and over a localhost TCP round trip, with a round-trip calculator and what a missing index does.

entry.title: Database indexes, measured
entry.summary: One million rows, real query plans: which queries an index speeds up, which it cannot, and what each index costs. With an in-browser SQLite playground.
